extracted.intended_audience: legal researchers, government employees, attorneys, regulated parties, and members of the public who use the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) index
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical and topical listing of CFR titles, chapters, subchapters, parts, and agencies appearing in the Code of Federal Regulations (as revised Jan 1, 2002). Intended as a reference/index to locate regulatory material by agency or CFR title/part ranges.
